doc: docs/proposed/RL-TRAINING-v2.md. Unit: 1.0 = one Crafter achievement. Every term is graded from what the server sends the player (statistics, advancements, time, death), never from the bot's own prediction.

survival.doc: Paid at dawn, for a night the bot was alive through from its start. Slept = in a bed when the night was skipped.

kills.doc: Statistic minecraft:killed:<entity>. Score of the n-th kill of one type in an episode = base * class * decay^(n-1), so farming one type is worth at most base * class / (1 - decay).

notable.doc: Replaces the kill score for these types. Bosses (no decay) are worth far more than anything else, so the reward for effort is visible.

mined.doc: Statistic minecraft:mined:<block>. Unlisted blocks (dirt, stone, sand, netherrack, ...) get `default`. Tiers rise with rarity; the n-th block of one type in an episode = tier * decay^(n-1).
mined.tool_doc: Owner 2026-11-02: blocks broken with a tool (the action layer's bestTool: the fastest held tool that harvests the block; null = the hand) score x tool_multiplier, so building tools first is worth slightly more. Tunnel: scaled by the share of its cells broken with a tool.

achievements.doc: Advancements the server grants (once per episode; reset revokes them). Score = per_step * steps, steps = depth in the advancement tree (modpack/forgeaip-create.advancements.json). Create's tab is a display chain, not prerequisites, so its advancements score flat.
achievements.unscored_doc: v4 (2026-11-02, run train5: 1,767 grants in 2,133 episodes): Create's root is awarded for free on joining, so it paid 1.0 per episode for nothing. Also from v4, advancements granted in the step the bot died are not scored: minecraft:adventure/root is granted by being killed (killed_by_something), and paid 1.0 for 2,022 deaths in that run, the opposite of survival.death = 0.

invalid.doc: Owner 2026-11-01, after the first training run collapsed onto commands that fail at once: a command that cannot be executed scores negative, charged per failed command by its reason. Failures the policy did not cause (died, disconnected, cancelled, internal) are free.

stages.doc: Weights per reward term, applied by the learner to reward_terms (the environment sends every term, unweighted). Stage 1 = survival; the small weight on the rest keeps the policy from settling on 'stay still and live' (DPOD 2026-09-27: noop was the best survival arm).
